observations: A separate isolated QA process used one Cursor parser pool with idle_release_timeout as the unitless JSON number 10. Claude was disabled in that test config; a dummy provider credential and loopback-only provider API URL prevented it from serving a real pool. The original QA Relay config was unchanged.

The test process exited code 1 in under one second. Its private log contained 'idle_release_timeout must be a duration such as 1h or 0' and a startup-failed indication, not the daemon-started message. No test-only listener persisted or QA workspace was created.
Both baseline pool-health gauges remained one. The private test config and log were removed after checksum and ownership review; no raw log or credential value is published.

events.summary: Private QA-only Cursor pool config contained unitless idle_release_timeout=10, disabled Claude, and used a dummy provider credential and unique loopback-only endpoints.
Launched the QA binary against the private invalid Cursor config.
Exit code 1; sanitized check of the private log confirmed idle_release_timeout must include a duration unit.
Serving QA Relay retained both healthy pools, no QA workspace visible and test-only ports unbound.
Private Cursor parser config and isolated log removed from the owned scratch directory.

cleanup: The isolated process exited code 1 at 00:09:48 UTC; its private config/log were removed at 00:10:12 UTC. Test ports 22114/22115 were unbound, no QA workspaces existed and the serving Relay retained its healthy baseline configuration.
